pull_requests.title: refactor(cli): rename the shared --store option to --notebook
pull_requests.body: Every jotbook subcommand takes the notes file through one shared option. People read --store as a database setting, so the option is now --notebook. add and list read it under the new name, and the README and tests follow.

pull_requests.title: feat(cli): add a search subcommand
pull_requests.body: jotbook search TERM prints every note containing TERM, ignoring case, numbered the way list numbers them. Like add and list, it reads the notes file the shared option names, falling back to JOTBOOK_FILE and then ~/.jotbook.json. It exits 1 when nothing matches.
